description.value: Vis-à-Vis is a wine bar and French-inspired bistro in the heart of Oak Bay Village, offering wine selected by an in-house sommelier alongside locally sourced lunch, dinner, and late-night menus. The bar-forward layout puts guests face-to-face with bartenders over wine, local craft beer, and signature cocktails. A private event room called Penny Lane accommodates groups of up to 40, and the business is managed by the VicPubCo hospitality group.
